resources.name: LinkedIn product-intent post search
resources.discovery_method: Manually search the Posts tab with Arabic and English launch-intent terms, then verify shortlisted people by exact name.
resources.harvesting_instructions: Run separate recent-post searches for (MVP OR beta OR launching OR platform OR marketplace OR mobile app) with (Saudi OR Riyadh OR Jeddah), then repeat with (نسخة تجريبية OR إطلاق OR منصة OR تطبيق OR شريك تقني) and (السعودية OR الرياض OR جدة). Open only posts with a named builder and verify the exact person and venture; do not infer intent from likes.
resources.future_usefulness: High for finding founders who publicly state a live product, MVP, launch, pilot, or developer need before the signal appears in databases.
resources.notes: Use post search before broad People search. Exact-name profile searches do not count toward LinkedIn's commercial-use limit, while general profile searching and profile browsing can. Search results and public visibility are incomplete and personalized.

evidence.source_title: Search for member posts | LinkedIn Help
evidence.paraphrased_evidence: LinkedIn documents post search and filters including date posted, content type, author, company, and industry.

evidence.source_title: Use Boolean search on LinkedIn | LinkedIn Help
evidence.paraphrased_evidence: LinkedIn supports uppercase AND, OR, and NOT, quoted phrases, and parentheses in its main search bar.
Broad profile search and browsing can consume the free commercial-use allowance; exact-name profile searches are excluded from that count.

resources.name: Misk Entrepreneurship LinkedIn stream
resources.discovery_method: Review official Launchpad announcements, MVP Sprint posts, cohort graduation posts, and named participant comments; verify each founder on their public profile.
resources.harvesting_instructions: Check for new Launchpad cohort, MVP Sprint, demo-day, and graduation posts. Search the post and comments for founders naming their venture and product. Record the cohort, product-stage statement, founder profile, and a second source. Ignore generic congratulations and unnamed attendees.
resources.future_usefulness: High because the official stream repeatedly surfaces idea-, MVP-, and early-launch-stage founders working in the Saudi ecosystem.
resources.notes: Cohort participation proves program participation, not Saudi incorporation, budget, or absence of an internal technical team. Reverify old cohort records before scoring timing.

evidence.paraphrased_evidence: The official Misk Entrepreneurship page describes its Saudi startup-building role and continues to publish Launchpad application and cohort activity.

evidence.source_title: MVPs in the making | Misk Entrepreneurship
evidence.paraphrased_evidence: The program's MVP Sprint post exposes founders building, testing, and receiving product feedback, including a named Aziz Platform founder in comments.

resources.name: 500 MENA and Sanabil Startup Unlocked LinkedIn stream
resources.geography: Saudi Arabia and MENA entrants to Saudi Arabia
resources.discovery_method: Review official Startup Unlocked batch announcements, founder sessions, demo days, and accelerator selections, then resolve founders by exact venture name.
resources.harvesting_instructions: Capture every named cohort company from official batch posts. For each company, search its exact name plus founder, verify a personal LinkedIn URL and Saudi operating intent, then look for a dated MVP, pilot, hiring, product-launch, or funding signal. Do not assume every MENA company is Saudi-based.

observed_yield.observation_window: Startup Unlocked batches 1 through 4 plus current accelerator posts

resources.future_usefulness: High because batch announcements provide a bounded, named company universe and later posts expose alumni, pivots, and product maturity.
resources.notes: Separate the five-day Startup Unlocked bootcamp from the investment accelerator. Participation alone is not funding evidence and Saudi program attendance alone is not Saudi-market proof.

evidence.paraphrased_evidence: The official page publishes current Startup Unlocked applications, founder lessons, and named alumni and accelerator companies.

evidence.source_title: Meet the Startups | Sanabil Startup Unlocked Batch 4
evidence.paraphrased_evidence: The official Batch 4 post names 18 early companies across AI, finance, healthcare, sustainability, and other sectors, creating a reusable enrichment queue.

resources.name: Zero to One | صفر لواحد LinkedIn page
resources.discovery_method: Scan recent Saudi business, app, startup, and AI launch coverage; follow named company links and verify the founder separately.
resources.harvesting_instructions: Review recent updates for Saudi companies introduced with launch, funding, new app, platform, MVP, or founder language. Open the named company page, identify founders by exact company, and retain only ventures with a current product-build signal. Do not treat general AI or market news as a lead.
resources.future_usefulness: Medium-high as an Arabic-language launch monitor with direct links to Saudi companies, but it requires aggressive filtering because most posts are not early-stage lead signals.
resources.notes: The public page identifies itself as a Riyadh business and investment media platform and showed frequent current updates. Its separate AI newsletter is duplicative and broader than the company stream.

evidence.source_title: Zero to One | صفر لواحد | LinkedIn
evidence.paraphrased_evidence: The Riyadh-based page describes its coverage as business and investment media and publishes frequent Saudi company, app, AI, and investment updates.

gaps.detail: This lane contains 20 raw candidate records. Four Misk Launchpad 7 records have product evidence older than one year and require a fresh exact-name check before they can count as active leads; none should be promoted solely from likes, generic comments, unnamed products, or ambiguous identities.
Public profile and post visibility varies by member settings, deletion, indexing, geography, and login state. A missing company, employee, or activity signal is unknown, not evidence of absence.

LinkedIn does not show the exact remaining free commercial-use allowance. Broad profile searches and profile browsing can consume it; exact-name searches do not. No automated profile traversal, extension, connection, follow, reaction, save, form submission, or message was used.

Most public pages do not establish whether a founder will outsource development. Where an internal CTO, engineering team, or technical founder was visible, the record is explicitly deprioritized; silence is retained as unknown.

The supplied Hasan Alsoud, Adwa AlDakheel, and Hamad Al-Hajri profile pages were not consistently retrievable through public web fetch. Their classification therefore relies on the supplied context plus retrievable linked posts, and none was counted among the four accepted resources.
Research remained read-only. Public posts sometimes displayed phone numbers or email addresses, but none were captured in this dataset.
